narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think a shape with a curved side cannot have a line of symmetry.
<bookmark mark='semi'/>Take a half circle and fold it through the middle of its straight edge. The curves overlap.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A curve is fine, as long as the same curve sits on both matching sides.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a drawing, fold along every line and count only the exact matches.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>If the count is wrong, change one curve so that both sides agree.
